facts.business: Indiabulls Limited operates as a diversified conglomerate with three main pillars: a capital-efficient real estate development model (premium residential, mid-income residential, commercial) using joint ventures and owned developments; diversified financial services verticals including stock broking, asset reconstruction, digital payments, NBFC lending, and equipment leasing; and a digital payments platform (Dhani) offering wallet services, UPI, and utility payments.

key_risks: Moderation in overall industry trading activity affecting broking revenue
